roles: target-year Y: train through Y-4; calibration Y-3; adaptation Y-2; selection Y-1; evaluation Y; origin embargo at previous-role end
cohort: non-excess at T; known exact-calendar onset outcome; complete ON predictors; same rows for every arm and climate contrast

policy.threshold: selection-only; maximize detected onsets subject to reference budget; keep whole score ties; prefer fewer false alerts; no-alert candidate always available
policy.noninferiority_reference: R0 on identical cohorts and periods; descriptive compliance is not statistical noninferiority

reference.use: optional frozen contextual comparator; paired only for exact ordered keys and equal truths

G1: NO_EVALUABLE: pinned canonical source contains only Meta and Tolima; no national source is authorized
profile_strata: NO_EVALUABLE: canonical contract has no validated transmission profile
global_hypothesis: NO_EVALUABLE: historical M00 already pooled all 76 municipalities and national expansion is unavailable
selection: G0 is the only available global source; adapt each fixed climate variant separately without choosing on evaluation outcomes
confirmation: none; 2024 is consumed retrospective stress; no 2025 outcomes, tuning, evaluation or champion selection
uncertainty: UNAVAILABLE for approval: four reused retrospective years; paired descriptive contrasts only; no confirmatory inference
hypothesis_rule: Global transfer NO_EVALUABLE without G1 because historical M00 already pools municipalities. Adaptation NO_RESPALDADA if paired G0/L1 descriptive sensitivity/load or year/department guardrails fail; otherwise NO_EVALUABLE pending sufficient independent inferential support. Never declare superiority from descriptive compliance.
